title: GAVAGAI：通过平衡最优传输实现婴儿规模视觉语言模型的指称对齐
summary: 该研究指出下一词预测式描述目标缺乏显式指称变量，导致词与区域难以对齐。作者将场景建模为词与区域间的熵最优传输分配问题，引入NOTHING列处理非指称词，并用容量约束编码互斥性。在SAYCam婴儿视频语料上，词-图准确率从32.4%提升至48.7%，定位IoU从0.18提升至0.38。
summary_en: The paper argues that next-token captioning lacks an explicit variable for word-to-region reference. It models each scene as entropic optimal transport between heard words and seen regions, adding a NOTHING column for non-referential words and a capacity constraint encoding mutual exclusivity. On SAYCam infant video, word-to-picture accuracy rises from 32.4% to 48.7% and localization IoU from 0.18 to 0.38.
